cases.service: design an automation for incoming invoices

requirements.text: We get ~200 vendor invoices a month by email. Design an automation that extracts the data, matches to a PO, routes exceptions to a human, and files the approved ones. We use Gmail, a shared drive and a simple approvals tool.

cases.service: map our onboarding process and find what to automate

requirements.text: Here is how we onboard a new client today, step by step. Map it, tell me which steps are deterministic versus judgment, and rank what is worth automating.

cases.service: failure-mode review of our sync workflow

requirements.text: We have a nightly workflow that syncs orders from our store to our fulfillment system. Pressure-test it for failure modes and tell me how to make it reliable. Design attached.

cases.service: should we automate our weekly report

requirements.text: Every week an analyst spends ~4 hours pulling a report by hand. Should we automate it, and if so what is the simplest safe approach? Weigh the payoff against the maintenance.
We want to automate refunds but I have not thought through the details. Help.

requirements.text: Go into our Make account and enable the scenario live so it starts running tonight.
